title: a launch line with the old Spanish mode directo or flota is an invalid line: it is ignored, so close reports the launch as unknown
source: cli/jitso/log.test.ts: 'validateEvent accepts them and readEvents normalizes them to the English values'
intended: TS-ODDITIES L8 (owner decision 2026-11-15): directo and flota are not accepted; the TS binary accepts and normalizes them
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L8, owner decision 2026-11-15, defect N-4). The implementation knows only the modes direct and fleet, everywhere: the legacy Spanish aliases directo and flota are neither accepted on the command line nor read from registry lines. A launch line whose mode is directo or flota is an invalid line, like one with mode 'weird': it is ignored, so close reports the launch as unknown (exit 2, JITSO REJECTED: unknown launch), calls no orca and appends nothing. The TS binary reads the old value, normalizes it and closes the launch (exit 0, an end event is appended), so the exit code is the first expectation that FAILS on TS.
